Route 9.lead_summary:
This route has two distinctive biome, which offers different catch tables:
*The first being a canyon, where several trainers and items are present, as well as two small patch of grass, which connects to the Cerulean City terminal.
*The second being a stream bank, with a large patch of grass, and connects to Route 10 and Cerulean Cape.
To reach Cerulean Cape, the player needs both Surf and Waterfall (or their respective HM Replacement Items).

Rock Tunnel.lead_summary:
Rock Tunnel is a dark cavern which splits the sections of Route 10. It is initially the only way to reach Lavender Town, due to the slumbering Snorlax and the Saffron gatekeepers.
Players will want to use either the HM08 Flash or its HM Replacement Item (see List of TMs for more info) to navigate through the cavern, although it is possible without them.
On B1F, behind some breakable rocks, there is an exit which leads to a small cave with an old man with an Easter egg.

Lavender Town can be accessed from the North by Route 10 (After Rock Tunnel), the West by Route 8, and the South by Route 12.
The main attraction of this town is the Pokémon Tower.

Celadon City.lead_summary:
Celadon City is a big city, with two entries: Route 16 to the West and Route 7 to the East.
This city contains Celadon City's Gym, with Erika as its leader.
Team Rocket have a hideout in the Celadon Sewers and Erika will help the player defeat them. After defeating Giovanni, the player will obtain the Silph Scope and can challenge Erika in her gym.

authoring_guidance.splicing_safety: Explicitly state: HEAD species, BODY species, and WHICH ability to select at the DNA Splicer prompt.
authoring_guidance.unfuse_safety: Unfusing at Pokémon Mart costs $300. Check move retention before unfusing.
authoring_guidance.gym_duel_rule: Strict 3v3 party limit! Instruct player to deposit extra party members in the PC before entering gym arena.
authoring_guidance.time_of_day: Provide Day/Night alternative suggestions so players are never blocked by real-time spawn windows.
authoring_guidance.stone_evolutions: Advisory: Do NOT use evolution stones prematurely on stone-evolvers (e.g. Nidorino) before key level-up moves are learned.
authoring_guidance.undercover_informant_rocket: Guide player to join Team Rocket for disguises/missions, BUT report crimes to police officer for +10 Karma and Diancie unlock!
